title.zh: Blockstream bets 600 Bitcoin by rejecting Liquid hacker’s $50 million bounty demand
title.en: Blockstream bets 600 Bitcoin by rejecting Liquid hacker’s $50 million bounty demand

current_state.zh: Blockstream is refusing the Liquid attacker's demand for nearly 600 BTC (~$50M) after 3,400 BTC was returned from the September exploit, leaving Liquid about 85% reserve-backed with peg-ins and peg-outs disabled.
current_state.en: Blockstream is refusing the Liquid attacker's demand for nearly 600 BTC (~$50M) after 3,400 BTC was returned from the September exploit, leaving Liquid about 85% reserve-backed with peg-ins and peg-outs disabled.
